entries.title: Create a one-second timer
entries.explanation: Register a timer named timer_1s. It runs once per second and starts automatically with the simulation.

entries.title: Handle the timer with a decorator
entries.explanation: The decorator connects this callback to timer_1s. Every time the timer elapses, the callback sends the Control_01 CAN message.

entries.title: Create and receive the CAN2 message
entries.explanation: Resolve Control_01 from the DBC on CAN2. The decorated callback runs whenever that message is received on CAN2 and prints the raw Activate signal value.
